limits: The first interval in each sample mixes performance.now with rAF timestamp and is excluded from frame interval summaries; raw values retained.
Only desktop Chromium measurement execution is present in this hosted report; seven WebKit activity functional cases are not a WebKit measurement run.
Five synthetic samples with twenty subsequent rAF intervals are not a p95 or universal frame-budget qualification.
Reload/open/scroll elapsed values are end-to-end intervals, not CPU/main-thread/frame-cost attribution.
No matched baseline/candidate hardware or physical/native/human acceptance claim is inferred.
